說明: 《千秋硯》第一批生圖清單：序卷、時之書齋、卷一〈大員〉的場景背景與角色頭像。ref 表示以另一張圖為參考、用圖生圖（edit）產生，以維持同一角色的長相。

style.bg: Traditional Chinese ink wash painting with light watercolor tints (shuimo with pale color), on textured xuan rice paper, soft layered washes, expressive calligraphic brushwork, muted earthy palette of ink black, indigo, ochre and pale jade, gentle atmospheric perspective, generous negative space, cinematic wide composition, the main subject placed in the middle horizontal band of the frame, no people in the foreground corners.
style.char: Bust portrait illustration in traditional Chinese ink wash with light watercolor tints, clean confident linework, soft washes on the clothing, subtle warm skin tones, calm expression, head and shoulders, face centered in the upper-middle of the frame, looking slightly to the viewer's left, single character only, isolated on a fully transparent background, no background, no frame.
style.negative: text, letters, words, calligraphy characters, signature, seal stamp, watermark, logo, border, frame, photograph, photorealistic, 3D render, CGI, plastic skin, anime, chibi, manga panel, speech bubble, oversaturated neon colors, lens flare, blurry, low quality, jpeg artifacts, deformed, bad anatomy, extra fingers, extra limbs, duplicate figures, collage, split image, modern objects in historical scenes, costume stereotypes, headdress, war paint, ritual ornaments

items.name: 神農街夜
items.prompt: A narrow old street in Tainan, Taiwan at night in the present day, two-storey old shophouses with wooden shutters on both sides, rows of red paper lanterns glowing warmly overhead, a small glass-fronted book restoration workshop with a warm light at the end of the lane, quiet, a few potted plants, wet stone pavement reflecting lantern light.

items.name: 修復工作室
items.prompt: Interior of a small modern book and paper restoration workshop at night, a wooden worktable under a warm desk lamp, an old yellowed land contract spread on the table with two columns of faded writing, fine brushes, bamboo tweezers, a magnifying glass, stacks of mulberry paper, an old purple inkstone, shelves of archival boxes, calm and intimate.

items.name: 祖父書房
items.prompt: An elderly scholar's study in an old Taiwanese house, floor-to-ceiling bookshelves crammed with genealogy books, old land deeds and handwritten notebooks, a desk with a dried-up teacup and an uncapped fountain pen, dust floating in late afternoon light from a window, a small locked wooden chest under the desk, nostalgic and still.

items.name: 時之書齋
items.prompt: A fantastical wooden scholar's study floating in an endless sea of slowly swirling ink clouds, open windows looking out onto the ink sea, bookshelves holding thread-bound books, bamboo slips, pottery shards and papyrus scrolls, a low desk with an inkstone, soft golden light, dreamlike and serene.

items.name: 茶室
items.prompt: A tiny tea room inside a floating wooden study, a low table with a clay teapot and two cups, two cushions, a round window showing drifting ink clouds, warm lamplight, steam rising from the tea, quiet and tender atmosphere.

items.name: 臺江岸邊
items.prompt: Wide tidal mudflats of a calm inner lagoon in southwestern Taiwan in 1636 at morning, shallow pools reflecting the sky, far across the water a long low sandbar with a small square European-style brick fortress with corner bastions, a few Chinese junks and small canoes, sea birds, hazy tropical light.

items.name: 刺竹林
items.prompt: A dense grove of tall thorny bamboo forming a green living wall around a village in 17th-century Taiwan, sharp thorns on the bamboo nodes, a narrow trodden footpath leading into a gap in the grove, dappled sunlight, humid subtropical air.

items.name: 新港社
items.prompt: A Siraya indigenous village in 17th-century southwestern Taiwan, houses with bamboo-woven walls and thick thatched roofs built on raised earthen platforms, deer antlers hung under some eaves, a large banyan tree in the middle, women working in millet fields beyond, a new simple schoolhouse building of a different style at the center, peaceful afternoon, respectful and historically grounded depiction, no ceremonies.

items.name: 新港學堂
items.prompt: Interior of a simple 17th-century mission schoolhouse in a Taiwanese village, bamboo and timber walls, wooden benches, children's slates and sheets of paper with Latin alphabet letters, light streaming from an open door, a wooden lectern, humble and bright.

items.name: 大榕樹
items.prompt: A huge old banyan tree with hanging aerial roots beside a thatched house on a raised earthen platform in a 17th-century Taiwanese village, a small bamboo stool in the shade, a few scattered bamboo shavings, warm late afternoon light, gentle and timeless.

items.name: 新港田野
items.prompt: Rolling millet and rice fields in 17th-century southwestern Taiwan, earthen field ridges, a distant line of thorny bamboo groves, tall grass at the edges, drifting humid evening mist, a few egrets, wide open sky.

items.name: 大員沙洲
items.prompt: The Tayouan sandbar in the 1640s, a Dutch East India Company fortress of red brick with angular bastions and tiered walls rising above white sand, warehouses and a small wharf piled with deer hides and crates, tall-masted Dutch ships at anchor, bright coastal light, sea breeze.

items.name: 往北的路
items.prompt: A lonely trail winding north across wild plains of 17th-century Taiwan, grass taller than a person swaying in the wind, distant blue hills, a small line of travelers far away on the path, overcast sky, melancholy and vast.

items.name: 北方河邊
items.prompt: A wide shallow river crossing on a plain in 17th-century Taiwan, clear water over pebbles, far bank with reeds and a path continuing north, soft light breaking through clouds, a sense of farewell, quiet.

items.name: 赤崁甘蔗田
items.prompt: Endless sugarcane fields taller than a person on the Sakam plain of Taiwan in 1652, long green leaves rippling like waves in the wind, a thatched field hut at the edge, distant white smoke rising from a traditional sugar boiling workshop, hot hazy afternoon.

items.name: 阿順草寮
items.prompt: Interior of a humble bamboo and thatch hut of a Hokkien tenant farmer in 17th-century Taiwan, a bamboo bed, a clay stove with a small fire, a conical bamboo hat hanging on the wall, a carrying pole leaning in the corner, bundles of sugarcane, dim warm light.

items.name: 赤崁街市
items.prompt: A lively Han Chinese market street in Sakam, Taiwan in the 1650s, open-fronted shops selling cloth, iron pots, herbs and dark sugar blocks, a blacksmith, a sugar workshop with smoke, notices pinned by doorways, busy but modest, Ming-era commoner clothing.

items.name: 公司館舍
items.prompt: Interior of a two-storey Dutch East India Company lodge in 17th-century Taiwan, a heavy wooden desk piled with documents and a quill, a small window looking out over sugarcane fields, whitewashed walls, a map on the wall, tense quiet atmosphere.

items.name: 甘蔗田大火
items.prompt: Sugarcane fields burning at night in 1652 Taiwan, towering flames and sparks rising into a dark sky, silhouettes of cane stalks, smoke drifting across a half moon, distant torches moving in the fields, dramatic and tragic, no gore.

items.name: 燃燒的糖廍
items.prompt: A traditional Taiwanese sugar boiling workshop on fire at night, overturned great iron cauldrons, dark molten sugar spilling across the ground, burning thatched roof, glowing embers, heavy smoke, eerie and dramatic.

items.name: 焦黑的甘蔗田
items.prompt: Dawn over burned sugarcane fields, blackened stubble and ash stretching to the horizon, thin wisps of smoke, a lone scorched field hut, pale grey sky, silent and mournful.

items.name: 北線尾船隊
items.prompt: Morning fog lifting over the sea off a sandbar in Taiwan in 1661, hundreds of Chinese war junks with battened sails filling the horizon, sailing toward a narrow shallow channel as the tide rises, distant Dutch fortress on the sandbar, awe-inspiring scale.

items.name: 臺江海戰
items.prompt: A 17th-century naval battle in a Taiwanese lagoon, a large Dutch warship exploding in a huge burst of fire and smoke, many small Chinese junks around it, burning debris falling onto the water, dramatic sky, seen from the distant shore.

items.name: 鄭軍營地
items.prompt: A vast Ming-style army encampment on the Sakam plain in 1661, rows of canvas tents, banners fluttering, rattan shields stacked, cooking smoke, in the distance a small European brick fort under siege, overcast sky.

items.name: 普羅民遮城
items.prompt: A small square European brick fortress with bastions in Sakam, Taiwan in 1661, under siege, rain falling, the gate slightly open, a line of weary people carrying bundles walking out, soldiers standing on both sides, muddy ground, somber.

items.name: 鹿耳門星夜
items.prompt: A small wooden boat on a narrow sea channel between sandbars at night, a sky full of stars with the pole star clear, calm black water reflecting starlight, faint lights of distant ships, mysterious and vast, a hint of an enormous dark shape beneath the water.

items.name: 圍城大員
items.prompt: The besieged Dutch fortress of Zeelandia in the winter of 1661, massive grey walls with angular bastions, smoke from cannon fire, a war-damaged harbor town of European-style houses occupied by Ming army tents, pale wintry light, a small hill with a redoubt beside the fortress.

items.name: 熱蘭遮城內
items.prompt: Inside a besieged 17th-century Dutch fortress, a dim stone corridor with arched ceilings, exhausted soldiers resting against the walls, a woman holding a baby sitting in a corner, a line of people with empty buckets near a well, cold grey light, heavy and sad, no gore.

items.name: 俘虜營篝火
items.prompt: Night at a makeshift prisoner enclosure of bamboo fences on a sandy plain, a small campfire outside the fence, a young soldier's rattan shield lying beside it, shadows of people huddled inside the fence, stars above, quiet and heavy.

items.name: 檔案室
items.prompt: A 17th-century fortress archive room crowded with wooden crates and bundles of documents, ledgers and books, pages floating in the air and turning blank white as grey smoke drifts from them, a single faceless figure in a black coat standing in the center, eerie supernatural ink-wash atmosphere.

items.name: 知墨
items.prompt: A gentle 27-year-old Taiwanese man, short neat black hair, calm attentive eyes, slight quiet smile, wearing a plain dark crew-neck T-shirt with a canvas work apron, the look of a careful book restorer.

items.name: 蘅
items.prompt: An ethereal girl who looks about 17, a spirit living inside an ancient inkstone, long black hair whose ends dissolve softly like ink dropped in water, slightly translucent pale skin, curious bright eyes, a faint mischievous smile, wearing a flowing light robe of no particular era in pale grey and indigo.

items.name: 蒂娃_12
items.prompt: A lively 12-year-old Siraya indigenous girl from 17th-century Taiwan, bright curious eyes, sun-tanned skin, black hair tied back simply, wearing a plain handwoven short cotton jacket in undyed and natural indigo tones, holding a small bamboo slingshot, brave and cheerful.

items.name: 蒂娃_16
items.prompt: The same girl, now 16 years old, taller and more mature, the same face and eyes, hair tied back, the same simple handwoven clothing style, a determined and sad expression. Keep the ink wash portrait style and the transparent background.

items.name: 蒂娃_28
items.prompt: The same person grown into an adult woman of 28: a mature adult face with defined cheekbones and a stronger jaw, no longer girlish, the same eyes, hair wrapped in a simple indigo cloth, a schoolteacher and mother, wise and tired but kind expression. Remove the slingshot: she no longer carries it; instead a plain wooden hunting bow is slung over her shoulder. Keep the ink wash portrait style and the transparent background.

items.name: 蒂娃_38
items.prompt: The same person as a middle-aged woman of 38: a mature adult face, slightly thinner cheeks, fine lines at the corners of her eyes and mouth, a few strands of white in her hair, the same eyes, a calm, resolute interpreter who speaks three languages. Remove the slingshot: her hands are empty and not holding anything. Keep the ink wash portrait style and the transparent background.

items.name: 楊_19
items.prompt: A 19-year-old Dutch young man in the 1630s, sun-faded blond hair, many freckles on his nose, earnest friendly eyes, wearing a simple dark wool doublet with a plain white linen collar, a clerk and translator of the Dutch East India Company.

items.name: 楊_23
items.prompt: The same man, now 23 years old, thinner face, shorter hair, the same freckles and eyes, a troubled and conflicted expression. Keep the ink wash portrait style and the transparent background.

items.name: 楊_35
items.prompt: The same man, now 35 years old, thinning blond hair, deeply sun-tanned, dark circles under his eyes, the same eyes, a weary official's dark coat. Keep the ink wash portrait style and the transparent background.

items.name: 楊_44
items.prompt: The same man, now 44 years old, graying hair, slightly stooped, gaunt cheeks, the same eyes, a quiet dignity. Keep the ink wash portrait style and the transparent background.

items.name: 阿順_30
items.prompt: A 30-year-old Hokkien Han Chinese tenant farmer in 1650s Taiwan, dark sun-tanned skin, a broad cheerful grin with teeth slightly stained red from betel nut, black hair in a simple topknot with a cloth band, wearing a patched cotton short jacket, a carrying pole over one shoulder.

items.name: 阿順_40
items.prompt: The same man, now 40 years old, half of his hair gone gray, deeper wrinkles, the same face, a gentler and sadder smile. Keep the ink wash portrait style and the transparent background.

items.name: 石頭
items.prompt: An 18-year-old soldier of Koxinga's Ming army in 1661, from Kinmen island, sun-tanned thin face, black hair in a topknot with a red headband, a bright grin showing one prominent canine tooth, wearing simple padded cloth armor, holding a round rattan shield, naive and kind.

items.name: 祖母
items.prompt: A dignified elderly Siraya indigenous woman of 17th-century Taiwan, completely white hair tied back, deep wrinkles, sharp clear black eyes full of wisdom, a calm faint smile, wearing a plain handwoven dark cloth garment, no ritual ornaments.

items.name: 阿洛
items.prompt: A broad-shouldered Siraya indigenous man of 17th-century Taiwan in his thirties, a few old scars on his arms, quiet steady eyes, reserved expression, simple handwoven clothing, a hunter, no war paint, no headdress.

items.name: 女兒
items.prompt: A 16-year-old Siraya indigenous girl from 17th-century Taiwan, a softer rounder face with a small chin, long black hair worn loose over one shoulder with a thin woven band, lively dark eyes, sun-tanned skin, wearing a plain handwoven short cotton jacket in undyed and natural indigo tones, a playful, proud and slightly mischievous expression, her hands empty.

items.name: 女兒_7
items.prompt: The same girl as a small 7-year-old child: a round chubby child's face, big curious eyes, short loose black hair, small shoulders, the same plain handwoven indigo clothing, a shy but mischievous smile, holding a small worn bamboo slingshot that is too big for her hands. Keep the ink wash portrait style and the transparent background.

items.name: 無面書記
items.prompt: An eerie faceless figure dressed as a 17th-century Dutch official, black coat with a white collar and a wide-brimmed black hat, where the face should be there is only a smooth blank surface like unwritten white paper, holding a white brush, elegant and unsettling, ink wash style.
